posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
that most likely means that sometime in the past you made the mistake and deployed into your project folder, or you never correctly separated the files after recreating the project folder from the deployed folder.
what folders do you currently have in your project folder? Is there a folder named WWW?
if yes then that is wrong - the www folder is deployment only and should never be in the project folder itself.
But depending on what other folders are there, sometimes you need to move folders and sometimes you'll have to copy the packages file from a new project
